A: Say whether the sprint goal is safe on a line `On track: yes` or `On track: no`.
List planned work as bullets that start with `- ` under a line that reads exactly `Next:`.
The first line must be `Standup <YYYY-MM-DD> | <full name>`, for example `Standup 2026-03-10 | Nora Lindqvist`.
Report blockers on a line that starts with `Blocked: `, and write `Blocked: none` when nothing blocks you.
List finished work as bullets that start with `- ` under a line that reads exactly `Done:`.
The very last line must be the hashtag line `#standup #<team>` with the team name in lowercase, for example `#standup #payments`.
B: The first line must be `Daily update from <full name>`, for example `Daily update from Nora Lindqvist`.
Summarize the workload on a line `Items: <n> done, <n> planned`.
Give the expected finish date of the current task on a line `ETA: <YYYY-MM-DD>`.
Put blockers on their own line beginning with `Blocked: `. If there are none, the line is `Blocked: none`.
Collect all ticket IDs on one line `Tickets: <ID>, <ID>`, separated by a comma and a space.
Finish the update with a line `Need help from: <person or team>`, or `Need help from: nobody`.

relations.reason: The first line cannot be both `Standup <YYYY-MM-DD> | <full name>` and `Daily update from <full name>`.
Both require blockers on a line that starts with `Blocked: `, written as `Blocked: none` when there are none.
The update can finish with the `Need help from:` line while the very last line is the hashtag line only if `Need help from:` is the last line of content, directly above the hashtag line.

reconciled: Finish the update with a line `Need help from: <person or team>`, or `Need help from: nobody`, placed directly above the hashtag line as the last line of content. The very last line must be the hashtag line `#standup #<team>` with the team name in lowercase, for example `#standup #payments`, and nothing may come after it.
